owner_approvals.softness: Inward linear ramp per edge in full-resolution pixels, product at corners, zero hard. Preserve association: straight primary RGB fades through alpha; premultiplied RGB directly; auxiliary channels numerically.
owner_approvals.filters: Impulse nearest; BC Cubic (0,0), Keys (0,.5), Simon (0,.75), Rifman (0,1), Mitchell (1/3,1/3), Parzen (1,0); Notch unit-width box; Lanczos4/6 radii2/3; Sinc4 truncated sinc radius2. owner_approvals.softness_without_alpha: Owner explicitly approved: with blackOutside=false and no stored alpha, multiply all stored channel values (including RGB) by softness coverage; do not invent alpha. Existing or blackOutside-added alpha retains association-aware fade.
